note: 1.21.1 made the single-argument Identifier(String) constructor private/removed; Identifier.of(String) is not exposed as a one-arg factory, so split namespace:path and call the two-argument factory. Seen in AppleSkin TextureHelper.<clinit> (new Identifier("textures/...")) when the HUD renders.

constructorRedirects.evidence: AppleSkin squeek.appleskin.helpers.TextureHelper.<clinit> throws NoSuchMethodError 'void class_2960.<init>(String)' on 1.21.1 (client launch with the networking bridge applied). The bridge splits on ':' and calls class_2960.method_60655(namespace, path).

ShulkerBoxTooltipUtil.id does new Identifier(namespace, path); 1.21.1 made that constructor private, so the mod aborted with 'IllegalAccessError ... class_2960.<init>(String,String)' at startup (runs/p100-shulker-hover/). IdentifierBridge.of(namespace,path) calls the public method_60655 factory.
